Chapter 10: Faith—Trusting the Unseen.
You know, there are moments on every journey where the road ahead just disappears into uncertainty. It’s like you’re walking into a fog, not sure what’s next. That’s exactly what the next scroll spoke about: faith. Not just faith in yourself, but in something bigger.
Think about it—most people freeze up when they can’t see what’s coming. They wait for some kind of guarantee before they take the next step. But the scroll encouraged Hafid to do something different. It told him to trust the process, to keep believing that his efforts would pay off, even when he couldn’t see the results right away.
Hafid started thinking back on all those times he’d hesitated, too scared to risk failing—or getting disappointed. Ever been there yourself? That fear kept him stuck, watching opportunities slip by. But the scroll’s wisdom was gentle, almost like a friend saying, “Hey, faith isn’t about being certain. It’s about moving forward even when you’re not.”
One evening, a huge storm hit the city. The marketplace flooded, stalls were destroyed, and merchants were left devastated. Hafid felt a wave of doubt, heavy and real. But then, he remembered the scroll’s advice: trust, keep showing up, and believe that better days are coming.
So, he got his friends together and started rebuilding. He lent a hand, shared some hope, and slowly, things began to change. The marketplace buzzed back to life. Customers returned, drawn in by the determination and optimism they saw. That’s when Hafid realized something powerful—faith spreads. When you hold onto it, you help others find it too, even when the odds seem impossible.
Hafid saw that most people give up when they can’t see quick results. They lose trust—in themselves, in others, and in the idea of a brighter future. But the scroll’s message was simple: keep trusting, keep moving, and believe your efforts matter, even if you can’t see the finish line yet.
Over time, Hafid’s faith turned into real strength. He faced new challenges with quiet confidence, knowing setbacks wouldn’t last forever—and that every bit of effort would eventually count for something.
Sure, the world stayed unpredictable. But his faith in the journey gave him the courage to keep going, no matter what came his way.
